notes: Verifier K, wave 4. Printed: 'When this creature enters, you may search your library and/or graveyard for a card named Garruk, Savage Herald, reveal it, and put it into your hand. If you search your library this way, shuffle.' Expectation from the text: choosing to search finds the named card in YOUR library and puts it into your hand (hand 0 -> 1); a differently named card stays, and the opponent's Garruk in their graveyard is never a candidate. (The last-listed library card, 'Opening Draw', is the runner's opening draw and is counted in the hand.)
